vetSays.line: 🛡️ Howard, the man in his 60s, Oscar and Zhasulan met them at the door — 4 put down. Howard, the man in his 60s, Oscar, Zhasulan are hurt.
🛡️ Oscar, Caleb, Sari and Sofia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Oscar, Caleb, Sari, Sofia are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sofia just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Howard, George, Caleb, Sari and Sofia met them at the door — 5 put down. Howard, George, Caleb, Sari are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder The Understudy falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Understudy!
📺 You brought down Elder The Understudy. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder The Understudy.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Grace taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Zhasulan has been turning the European Elder over — asking after it at fires, handling it on work days — and now knows it deep enough to teach. (Their trade grows: ask them what they know.)
Grace has been turning the European Elder over — asking after it at fires, handling it on work days — and now knows it deep enough to teach. (Their trade grows: ask them what they know.)
Grace is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
💡 European Elder: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lena just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ingrid and Lena met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Ingrid, Lena are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Ingrid and Lena met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Lena is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Raj just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Catalina just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
